name: LoadoutSwitcher
description: Hotkey switching of saved in-game loadouts (Role Plans), with toast feedback.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Stellar Settings — Hotkeys: the loadout group with apply.1–apply.8 bindings.

changed: Switching to a loadout now switches its whole Deep-Slumber, including the tree — not just the phantom factors. If the loadout's Deep-Slumber uses a different tree, it rebuilds the tree for you instead of stopping half-done, and it no longer stutters while it applies. Re-save (Bind) each loadout once on this version so its current Deep-Slumber tree is captured.
